people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘You shall eat no fat, of bull, or sheep, or goat.
translations.bsb: “Speak to the Israelites and say, ‘You are not to eat any of the fat of an ox, a sheep, or a goat.
translations.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, Ye shall eat no manner of fat, of ox, or of sheep, or of goat.
